extracted.intended_audience: general public, supporters/donors, activists, partner organizations, and policymakers
extracted.subtask_description: An informational 'About' page describing NRDC’s mission, history, methods of work (advocacy, litigation, science, partnerships), geographic programs, financial transparency, sustainability practices, and affiliate relationships. Intended to explain how NRDC operates and what it prioritizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC works to safeguard the earth—its people, its plants and animals, and the natural systems on which all life depends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine membership/activist power with expertise (scientists, lawyers, environmental specialists) to confront climate crisis, protect wildlife and wild places, and ensure rights to clean air, clean water, and healthy communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy approach
rubrics_metrics.description: From mayors’ offices to Congress to international negotiating tables, we work at every level to persuade decision makers to adopt solutions for lasting environmental change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mobilize strategic coalitions and the grassroots power of millions of activists to urge elected officials to put the public interest ahead of polluting industries; work with industry associations when helpful to improve policy elements and win support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity partnerships and community-centered practice
rubrics_metrics.description: We are pursuing an integrated approach to addressing persistent and connected threats of environmental inequality, racial injustice, and socioeconomic insecurity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with frontline groups to advance community-driven solutions, help build power in communities most harmed by inequities, and push for long-lasting change—centering communities most harmed by environmental and climate impacts in science and policy work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation as a core strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: We litigate across a broad range of environmental and public health issues, often working closely with NRDC’s subject-matter experts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attorneys may represent other nonprofit organizations, community groups, and individuals; example language notes frequent, high-volume litigation (e.g., NRDC sued 163 times in a prior administration and prevailed in nearly 90% of resolved cases) and taking administrations to court over rollbacks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science integration and use of expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Science Office bridges the gap between science and the people, wildlife, and ecosystems it serves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Harness science as a tool to support a greater environmental movement that centers communities most harmed by environmental and climate impacts; use scientific, economic, and policy expertise to spearhead breakthroughs globally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership-driven legal standing and outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC has relied on a robust direct-mail program to recruit and maintain the large Membership that gives us standing in court to bring legal action in defense of our environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate by postal mail—and other channels—not only to generate income but to mobilize the public in direct-action campaigns (petitions to corporations and government agencies); in accordance with FASB guidelines, NRDC allocates a portion of direct-mail costs to program services and to fundraising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial transparency and accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit incorporated under the laws of the State of New York and posts financial statements and IRS Form 990.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top watchdog groups recognize commitment to transparency and efficiency (example: four-star Charity Navigator rating and A- Charity Watch grade); provide FY financial statements and past annual reports for public review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability of operations
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC is committed to leading the green-building industry through action and leverages widely respected sustainable building standards across global operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive to reduce resource consumption and increase resource production in offices; reported achievements since 2012 include declines in carbon emissions (↓31%), water consumption (↓32%), and waste to landfill (↓27%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic and programmatic focus (where we work)
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC works regionally across the United States (Arctic, East, Midwest, Puerto Rico, West) and internationally (Canada, China, India, Latin America).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional descriptions emphasize local advocacy priorities (e.g., defending Arctic landscapes, promoting climate action in the Midwest, restoring power/water in Puerto Rico) and program examples like the India Initiative and high-seas marine protected areas work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnerships and outreach channels
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC pursues Entertainment Partnerships and Global Collaborations to increase awareness and advance priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partner with media, brands, celebrities, festivals, art institutions, and social media platforms to raise awareness; collaborate internationally with local partners and global forums to advance conservation and sustainable development objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliates and political advocacy structure
rubrics_metrics.description: NRDC Action Fund is the 501(c)(4) affiliate whose mission is to build political support in the United States for protecting the planet and its people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain separate affiliate structures (e.g., Action Fund) to engage in political advocacy while NRDC remains a 501(c)(3); also partner with nonpartisan groups (example: E2) to advance policies that benefit economy and environment.
